text:
Marta K: Quick update from the longform onboarding run for vela-13b. We compared int6 vs int8 on the long-article summarization slice (~1.1k avg out). int8 cuts cost a lot but quality drift in long tails. Thoughts?

Sam: Numbers and sample size?

Marta K: 1,800 examples, human spot n=220. eval-bot below.

eval-bot: |metric|int6|int8|delta|
|---|---:|---:|---:|
|ROUGE-L|43.4|40.6|-2.8|
|BLEU|11.9|10.6|-1.3|
|Hallucination|5.0%|7.9%|+2.9pp|
|Cost/1k tokens|$0.121|$0.080|-34%|

Leo: Unit econ: ~34% token cost reduction -> meaningful monthly savings at scale. But hallucination +2.9pp on long outputs is product-risky.

Priya: Latency: int8 p50 ~11% faster, p95 same. So cost is the lever. Human pref on long outputs: int6 preferred 62% -> 38% (n=220).

Sam: Proposed conservative routing: default int8, but route expected_output>=750 OR slice==multi-doc to int6. Start with 10% GTN canary for 48h, then 25% holdback. Immediate fallback to int6 if hallucination_rate > baseline +1pp for 3h.

Marta K: Routing JSON planned: {"routes":[{"cond":"expected_output>=750 or slice==multi-doc","model":"vela-13b-int6"},{"cond":"default","model":"vela-13b-int8"}],"initial_canary_pct":"10","holdback_pct":"25","fallback":"vela-13b-int6"}

Priya: Add monitors: ROUGE-L drift alert at 1.5 points on canary slices, hallucination +1pp alert, ngram-repetition for outputs>600 tokens. Wire human NPS panel for holdback.

Leo: +1. Also save counterexamples for product and create a small VIP shadow on fp16.

Marta K: I'll file the scorecard (slices: long-article, multi-doc, instruction-heavy) and roll the flag vela-13b-routing-v1 tomorrow morning. Staging deploy at 09:00 PT. :thumbsup:
